title: The shape of a good Dockerfile

blocks.content: Pin the base image, install dependencies from a lockfile, copy source last, then declare how the thing starts. That ordering is what makes rebuilds fast.

FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev

COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

blocks.title: CMD or ENTRYPOINT
blocks.content: ENTRYPOINT sets the command that always runs; CMD sets arguments a caller can replace. If you want `docker run myapp --help` to work, the binary belongs in ENTRYPOINT.
